items: Bike parking: Overtoom 2-4-6, hoek Nassaukade 391, 393-394, 1054 AE Amsterdam

blocks.title: Getting to the lobby
blocks.photoAlt: Reception desk and staircase in the Box Amsterdam office lobby

paragraphs.html: Please head to the main WeWork entrance from Stadhouderskade 5. Use the tablets available at the reception desk to register as a Box guest (choose your interviewer as host).

cards.title: Photo ID
cards.body: Please bring a valid government ID (license, passport, or other government-issued ID) to verify your identity at check-in.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the link provided by your Recruiting Coordinator.

cards.title: Arrival & departure
cards.body: Your interviewer will meet you at the reception and escort you to the conference room.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
